[[File:Skill Assend Right Value.webp|thumb]]
When player ascend their skills, the star will only boost their flat values, which is the the numbers on the right side.




[[File:Skill Assend Left % Side.webp|thumb]]
When player ascend the quality, like from rare to epic, both percentage and flat values will be boosted.







When you ascend the stars, your curent value will be boost around 15%~30%. It seems a lot, but is not. Normally, percentages and flat values each make up half, so even your flat value boosted 30%, it is only 15% of your skill total value. If this skill deal 30% of your total damage, which means a star only boost 5% of your total damage. As the result, the quality ascend makes more important role. When you are using your skill shard vouchers, make sure that after you reach a specific quality, then just stop and use your vouchers on other important skills.

Usually technique skill will gain 25% for quality and charm is 20%. As long as you know the rough ascend percentage, you can easily predict the final immortal quality's value.

If the Epic Boiling Bloodlust gives you 30% of your Crit Rate, then rest of the qualities will be: 30% -> 38% -> 47% -> 59% -> 73% Which is very close to in-game value, 70%

Lets try a charm. If the Lengendary Blade of Lament gives you 2.44% of your lifesteal, then rest of the qualities will be: 2.44% -> 2.93% -> 3.51% -> 4.22%
[[File:Skill Full Value Example.webp|thumb]]
Your "flat value only" skills also follow the rule, but sometimes it might confuse you since your skill level only affect the flat value.
